_note: Donations allowed at half: "an amount equal to 50% of the aggregate of the sums paid as donation by an assessee during the tax year to" s.133(1)(b)(i) the Prime Minister's Drought Relief Fund, without limit, and (ii)–(vi) — a registered or approved charitable fund or institution, the Government or a local authority for a charitable purpose other than family planning, a housing or town-planning authority, a notified minority-community corporation, an entity repairing a notified place — within s.133(2)'s qualifying limit (p.169); Income-tax Rules, 2026 Form No. 114 note 5 (p.2217): "Donor shall be eligible for deduction of 50% of the donation made subject to 10% of adjusted gross total income as per section 133(2)". Base AMOUNT_PAID, the sum counted. A (b)(ii) donation is allowed only on the donee's report (s.133(6)). Old regime only: s.202(2)(a)(xii) excludes Chapter VIII other than ss.124(1), 124(2), 125(2) and 146 (p.227). TY 2026-27 only; the 1961 counterpart, s.80G, is unread (W-075d). rulebook DED-80G-001.
